title: show a message when network is disabled due to a vault being open
line: Opening a vault set to go offline now shows a notification saying that networking was turned off because of that vault.
explanation: When a vault with "Go offline while this vault is open" is unlocked, the Plasma Vault kded module calls NetworkManager to disable networking, but nothing tells the user why. The Networks widget only sees that networking is off, so someone who forgot the vault setting has no clue where to look. The module now sends a "Networking disabled" notification naming the vault when such a vault opens (new plasmavault.notifyrc, so it can be configured in System Settings), and withdraws it when the vault is closed.

commits.message:
kded: notify when networking is turned off for an offline vault

Opening a vault set to go offline switched networking off silently, so
people who forgot about the setting were left wondering why they had no
network. Now a notification says which vault turned networking off.

BUG: 501238

media.caption: Master: right after unlocking the offline-only vault "Private" networking is off (NetworkingEnabled=false) but nothing explains it
With the fix: a Plasma Vault notification says networking was turned off while the vault "Private" is open

reviews.text: Adding a notification from plasma-vault when an offline-only vault turns networking off is a useful idea, but by itself a transient popup does not fully satisfy the bug report, which specifically asked for the Networks widget to explain why the system is offline. If the user misses the 5-second toast, is in Do Not Disturb mode, or tries to use the internet later while the vault is still open and clicks the Networks widget to troubleshoot, there is still no indication of why networking is disabled. Additionally, the notification fires unconditionally even when plasma-vault is built without NetworkManager support (HAVE_NETWORKMANAGER=false, where setNetworkingEnabled is a no-op stub) or when networking was already disabled.
changes: Surface the offline-vault reason inside the Networks widget (plasma-nm) while networking is inhibited by an open vault (for example, by exposing an optional D-Bus property/state from plasma-vault that plasma-nm checks when networking is disabled, without adding a hard dependency), so users checking the Networks widget after a toast expires or during Do Not Disturb still see why they are offline.

Guard the plasma-vault notification with #if HAVE_NETWORKMANAGER and only emit it when networking was actually enabled before being turned off, so it never falsely claims networking was disabled when built without NetworkManagerQt or when networking was already off.
